name: Accountable executive
description: Senior officer or system owner personally accountable for the agent's decisions. Sets risk appetite and tolerance, signs go-live, tier promotion and the oversight pack.

name: Business sponsor
description: Funds the agent and owns the benefit case.

name: Agent owner
description: New role. Day-to-day accountable for one agent: mandate, inventory, change, the oversight pack. Usually the product lead of the business process.

name: Product owner
description: Owns the backlog, including control stories, and user-facing artefacts.

name: Delivery engineering
description: Builds the agent, evaluation harness and release attestations.

name: Security
description: Threat modelling, identity, red-teaming, supplier security review.

name: Data owner / DPO
description: Approves what data and context the agent may read and remember.

name: Risk & compliance (2nd line)
description: Embedded in the delivery team. Runs hazard analysis, owns the control catalogue, approves mandates.

name: Platform engineering
description: Builds and runs the evidence infrastructure. Records are emitted by the platform automatically.

name: Independent review & validation
description: Independent of the agent owner. Runs the sampling loop and calibration, evaluates T3+ agents before release.

name: Operations
description: Runs the process today, holds the kill switch, first-line QA.

name: Internal audit (3rd line)
description: Agrees the tile register before go-live. Relies on records rather than re-collecting evidence.
